I need to run through our standard review before I can make a disposition decision. Let's hear from each function — Quality, do we have any findings on the temperature excursion and its impact on the adhesive? Maintenance, anything on the receiving equipment or alarm conditions? Logistics, what's the staging situation and any replacement shipment options? And EHS, any concerns we should be aware of? I need to get this resolved because Friday's production schedule is depending on this material.
